violations.description: General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil * was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. . Countertop between the 3 compartment sink and the prep sink is in need of repair. Water is able to seep under the cracked and missing luminant top.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Floors, walls, and/or ceiling * were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. . Floor drain is in need of repair. linoleum around the drain is peeled back and water can seep into the under sub floor.
